title: Ile naprawdę kosztuje auto przez rok?
imageSuffix: cinematic film still, photorealistic, warm golden hour tones, amber and teal color grade, shallow depth of field, anamorphic lens, 35mm film grain, dramatic lighting, vertical composition, highly detailed, no text, no watermark

segments.text: Myślisz, że auto kosztuje tylko tyle, ile zapłacisz w salonie? Policzmy, ile naprawdę wydasz w jeden rok!
shots: a shiny new hatchback car in a modern car dealership showroom, warm spotlights, reflections on polished floor
close-up of a hand holding new car keys with a leather keychain, car dealership in the background, bokeh
young man smiling behind the steering wheel of a new car, sunlight through the windshield

segments.text: Na start ubezpieczenie OC. Około 1200 zł.
shots: car insurance documents and a pen on a wooden desk next to car keys, warm desk lamp light, close-up
hands signing an insurance contract on a desk, warm window light, close-up

segments.text: Potem paliwo. Przy 15 tysiącach kilometrów to mniej więcej 6500 zł.
shots: close-up of a fuel nozzle filling a car at a gas station at dusk, glowing lights
a gas station at night with warm neon lights and a car at the pump, wet asphalt reflections
car driving on a European highway at sunset, motion blur, aerial view

segments.text: Serwis, olej i przegląd techniczny? Kolejne 1500 zł.
shots: mechanic working under a lifted car in a garage workshop, warm work lights, sparks of light
close-up of golden engine oil being poured into a car engine, macro

segments.text: Opony i sezonowa wymiana to około 800 zł rocznie.
shots: stack of new car tires in a tire shop, dramatic side light
mechanic changing a car wheel with an impact wrench, close-up, garage

segments.text: Do tego parking, myjnia i drobne naprawy. Następne 1000 zł.
shots: car covered in white foam in a car wash, colorful warm light, water droplets
car parked on a city street at golden hour, parking meter in the foreground
close-up of a cracked car headlight, moody warm light

segments.text: A największy koszt? Utrata wartości. Nawet 8000 zł w jeden rok!
shots: a lonely car parked in the rain at night under a street lamp, moody, warm orange light, rain drops
a used car on a lot with a sale sign on the windshield, sunset, dramatic sky
close-up of a car speedometer and dashboard glowing orange in the dark

segments.text: Razem około 19 000 zł. To ponad 1500 zł co miesiąc!
shots: worried man looking at bills and a calculator at a kitchen table, warm evening light
open empty leather wallet on a car seat, close-up, warm light

segments.text: A ile ty wydajesz na swoje auto? Napisz w komentarzu!
shots: car driving on an empty country road toward the sunset, rear view, lens flare, epic wide shot
